title: An Energy Stable Approach for Learning Derivative Operators from Noisy Data for Maxwells Equations
summary: We develop a structure-preserving ADMM method, denoted SP-ADMM, for learning energy-stable spatial derivative stencils for Maxwell equations from noisy data. Starting from the source-free Maxwell system, we focus on a one-dimensional reduction whose energy conservation depends on the skew-adjointness of the spatial derivative operator. The learned derivative is represented by a compact periodic convolution stencil. Unlike standard constrained ADMM, which learns the full stencil and imposes skew-adjointness through equality constraints, SP-ADMM enforces skew-adjointness by construction…
